_about: Cards for the owner's connected mailbox. Offered only while an email account is connected (contract supported).

email.read.use_when: The person wants to know what is in their inbox or find an email they received.
examples: what did the landlord say in his last email
find the email with my flight booking
est-ce que j'ai reçu un mail de pierre
not_for: how do I set up email on my phone
write an email to my landlord

email.draft.save.use_when: The person wants an email written and kept ready for them to review before it is sent.
examples: draft an email to the landlord about the boiler
write a reply to sam saying I'll be late and let me check it
prepare an email to my accountant asking for the forms
not_for: what makes a good email subject line
